2026-10-07-horizontal-up-microfluidic-ch.description: An embedded two-phase microfluidic cooler combines horizontal liquid inflow with vertical vapor removal. Its dielectric working fluid reached a critical heat flux of 1,570 W/cm².

2026-10-08-google-constellation-nuclear-.title: Where do the 890 MW in Google’s nuclear deal come from?
2026-10-08-google-constellation-nuclear-.description: Google and Constellation are supporting equipment upgrades at 11 existing reactors. The agreement distinguishes 890 MW of added capacity from 2,700 MW of existing contracted supply.

2026-10-08-overhead-cable-radiative-cool.title: A cooling coating for power lines: measuring temperature and predicting current capacity
2026-10-08-overhead-cable-radiative-cool.description: An outdoor test measured the behavior of a simulated cable. A separate CIGRE-based model estimated ampacity, leaving the increase in current on an operating transmission line to be demonstrated.

2026-10-08-single-crystal-cof-carbon-cap.title: A carbon-capture membrane with 75% COF crystal loading
2026-10-08-single-crystal-cof-carbon-cap.description: A mixed-matrix membrane packs single-crystal covalent organic frameworks into a polymer. It combines a CO₂ permeability of 74,800 Barrer with a CO₂/N₂ selectivity of about 20.

2026-10-09-blog-automation-living-guide.title: How JJo takes a blog post from a reader’s question to publication
2026-10-09-blog-automation-living-guide.description: The editorial workflow covers checking sources, equations and figures, parallel review, version control, approval and verification after publication. The article identifies the steps already tested and the remaining cloud and Blogger integration work.

2026-10-09-feather-star-soft-swimmer-new.title: A soft robot swims in three dimensions with two pneumatic inputs
2026-10-09-feather-star-soft-swimmer-new.description: Flexible fins modeled on a feather star produced vertical motion, forward and backward swimming, and turns. Tests reached 1.64 body lengths per second and 90 degrees per second with an external air supply. Long-term durability remains open.

2026-10-09-sando-safe-dynamic-trajectory.title: Can a drone’s collision avoidance be guaranteed mathematically?
2026-10-09-sando-safe-dynamic-trajectory.description: MIT’s SANDO plans paths through unknown environments using time-dependent corridors that account for moving obstacles. The analysis examines the continuous-time safety assumptions, the comparison behind a 7.4-fold optimization speedup and failures on hardware.

2026-10-09-tongue-controlled-fes-exoskel.title: Controlling a hand exoskeleton with the tongue: a five-person study
2026-10-09-tongue-controlled-fes-exoskel.description: A tongue sensor, tendon-driven exoskeleton and functional electrical stimulation helped five participants with cervical spinal cord injuries grasp objects. The 96% and 89% task success rates are interpreted alongside experimenter assistance and the limits of short tests.

2026-10-10-cuopt-mpdlp-multi-gpu-news.title: When do more GPUs speed up optimization? A look at mPDLP
2026-10-10-cuopt-mpdlp-multi-gpu-news.description: NVIDIA’s multi-GPU linear programming solver illustrates how communication becomes a bottleneck. The article separates iteration time from end-to-end runtime and explains the effects of small problems and uneven partitions.

2026-10-10-endometriosis-spatial-neuroim.title: Mapping cells in endometriosis lesions: what can the map tell us about pain?
2026-10-10-endometriosis-spatial-neuroim.description: Researchers mapped cell positions in human tissue and measured responses in cell co-cultures. Direct patient pain measurements and treatment effects were outside the study’s scope.

2026-10-10-neural-crest-nuclear-confinem.title: How does a cell nucleus survive a tight squeeze?
2026-10-10-neural-crest-nuclear-confinem.description: Zebrafish neural crest cells deform as they move through confined tissue. The study tracks Lamin B2 and DNA damage and sets limits on extrapolation to adult humans or cancer treatment.

2026-10-14-cacheflex-l2-scratchpad-news.title: CacheFlex turns part of the L2 cache into a workspace
2026-10-14-cacheflex-l2-scratchpad-news.description: Even a fast CPU can stall while it waits for data. CacheFlex lets a program manage part of the storage near the core as a scratchpad.

2026-10-14-cpu-gpu-uma-memory-sharing-ne.title: Why sharing memory still costs CPUs and GPUs time
2026-10-14-cpu-gpu-uma-memory-sharing-ne.description: Measurements on four unified-memory platforms separate data transfer from completion signals and compare correctness, cache policy and application performance.

2026-10-14-iot-ai-self-replication-news.title: AI self-replication on IoT devices: what did the report test?
2026-10-14-iot-ai-self-replication-news.description: Anthropic evaluated distributed inference and replication in an emulator as separate tasks. The report did not demonstrate an autonomous worm spreading on real devices.

2026-10-15-iea-ai-data-centre-grid-integ.title: New rules for connecting AI data centers to the grid
2026-10-15-iea-ai-data-centre-grid-integ.description: An IEA comparison of 34 jurisdictions examines how connection queues, non-firm access, tariffs and reliability interact when planning grid connections.

2026-10-15-pjm-emergency-order-backup-ge.title: What PJM’s emergency order tells us about backup power
2026-10-15-pjm-emergency-order-backup-ge.description: The US Department of Energy issued a temporary order ahead of maintenance and rising demand. A nationwide 35 GW estimate does not establish how much backup power was available locally.

2026-10-15-tva-grid-expansion-84-project.title: TVA’s 84 grid projects and the projected 2.5 GW
2026-10-15-tva-grid-expansion-84-project.description: The US Department of Energy announced a $581 million plan for 84 TVA transmission and distribution projects, including $250 million in federal support. Capacity, jobs and benefits are projections.

2026-10-16-computational-metalloprotease.title: AI-designed zinc enzymes that cut proteins
2026-10-16-computational-metalloprotease.description: A Nature study reports designed metalloproteases that cleave a specified peptide bond. The article examines the experimental result, slow catalysis and limits of therapeutic claims.

2026-10-16-fomo-multiseason-robot-naviga.title: Robot mapping through snow and forest
2026-10-16-fomo-multiseason-robot-naviga.description: The FoMo dataset includes raw multisensor records from 12 repeated seasonal runs over a year and 64 km. It lets researchers compare where SLAM fails as conditions change.

2026-10-16-satellite-methane-blind-test-.title: Satellite methane detection in a year-long blind test
2026-10-16-satellite-methane-blind-test-.description: A Nature study tested 12 satellites and 15 analysis teams in 746 controlled releases and blank trials to measure detection rates and false positives.

2026-10-17-autonomous-wet-lab-verid-news.title: An autonomous lab learns from its digital twin
2026-10-17-autonomous-wet-lab-verid-news.description: Google Research combined lab-state tracking, simulation and execution logs to identify liquid-handling errors and correct experiments in an early demonstration.

2026-10-17-magic-state-cultivation-news.title: Magic-state cultivation targets a quantum computing bottleneck
2026-10-17-magic-state-cultivation-news.description: A Willow processor experiment reported roughly 40 times less magic-state error. Its 8% retention rate and the cost of scaling qualify that result.

2026-10-17-perovskite-led-additive-pathw.title: The hidden chemistry of additives in perovskite LEDs
2026-10-17-perovskite-led-additive-pathw.description: A Nature study separated beneficial and harmful pathways of the 5AVA additive, reporting 97.2% average PLQY and 37.1% peak EQE. Device lifetime remains a separate question.

2026-10-18-coral-extinction-risk-news.title: What does it mean that 44% of coral species are threatened?
2026-10-18-coral-extinction-risk-news.description: Researchers reassessed 892 species and classified 340 of the 774 with sufficient data as threatened. The analysis examines the proxies and the SSP2-4.5 scenario behind the result.

2026-10-18-ferroptosis-self-organization.title: How cell arrangement shapes waves of ferroptosis
2026-10-18-ferroptosis-self-organization.description: A Cell study examines how density, alignment, YAP and NRF2 signaling, and lipid polarity influence where oxidative cell death spreads and stops.

2026-10-18-zr-oxyhalide-solid-electrolyt.title: A self-passivating solid electrolyte tested at 10C
2026-10-18-zr-oxyhalide-solid-electrolyt.description: A zirconium electrolyte study targets conductivity and interface stability at high voltage. The test used 50 MPa pressure and a lithium–indium anode.

clinical-llm-validation-framework.title: Validating clinical LLMs across 920,000 notes
clinical-llm-validation-framework.description: Rules, grounding checks, independent judgments, expert samples and clinical outcomes helped validate information extraction without a complete answer key. External validation remains open.

leash-agent-escalation.title: When should a smaller agent call a stronger model?
leash-agent-escalation.description: LEASH uses uncertainty in hidden states to escalate selected computer-use tasks. The preprint compares cost and success on OSWorld and identifies gaps in validation.

oncology-consultation-ai.title: Can AI reduce the work of preparing for a first oncology visit?
oncology-consultation-ai.description: A before-and-after study with nine clinicians and 33 consultations reported less work and time spent. The small sample, lack of a control group and industry interests limit interpretation.

airscope-wireless-cortex-imaging.title: A 1 g wireless microscope images the cortex of freely moving mice
airscope-wireless-cortex-imaging.description: Airscope’s quoted mass excludes the battery. The article examines its field of view, wireless transmission and the checks used to validate cortical signals.

miopm-multi-immersion-light-sheet.title: The miOPM light-sheet microscope with interchangeable objectives
miopm-multi-immersion-light-sheet.description: One optical system accepts oil, water and air objectives and maintains diffraction-limited performance across refractive indices from 1.33 to 1.51. Alignment remains a practical constraint.

multi-ancestry-breast-cancer-gwas.title: A GWAS of 1.9 million people expands the breast cancer risk map
multi-ancestry-breast-cancer-gwas.description: A meta-analysis of African, Asian and European ancestry populations reported 415 risk loci. The article examines statistical power, unequal representation and clinical validation.

2026-10-21-analog-fft-sonos-news.title: Computing a 65,536-point FFT inside memory
2026-10-21-analog-fft-sonos-news.description: A study computes Fourier transforms in charge-trapping SONOS memory. Hardware audio and image tests, application models and analog-to-digital conversion costs establish different accuracy limits.

2026-10-21-sixppac-wireless-ml-engine-ne.title: What did a wireless chip do with 4.18 nJ?
2026-10-21-sixppac-wireless-ml-engine-ne.description: SIXPPAC integrates two SAR converters with a binary-weight neural network. The article traces the test conditions behind the 4.18 nJ figure and the separate streaming-mode measurements.

directed-cathode-interlayer-solar-cell.title: Controlling molecular orientation at an organic solar cell interface
directed-cathode-interlayer-solar-cell.description: A methanol pretreatment followed by a PDI interlayer changes charge extraction in a binary organic solar cell. The article follows the measurements, efficiency results and limits.

doe-grid-resilience-funding.title: Will US grid resilience grants reduce outages?
doe-grid-resilience-funding.description: US Department of Energy allocation tables and application procedures for fiscal years 2025 and 2026 distinguish amounts allocated, funds spent and measured outage outcomes.

spectral-swarm-arena-shape.title: How does a robot swarm “hear” the shape of its arena?
spectral-swarm-arena-shape.description: Robots exchange internal states with their neighbors and use diffusion decay to estimate the graph’s second eigenvalue. Two experimental platforms show where the method works.

t-wla-vision-touch.title: T-WLA connects slow vision with fast touch
t-wla-vision-touch.description: The update sequence and residual equations show how tactile feedback corrects action chunks proposed by vision, alongside the experimental results and remaining questions.

flora-robotics-data-engine.title: Labeling 200,000 hours of robot video
flora-robotics-data-engine.description: How does NVIDIA Flora record actions in robot video? The article compares model performance, throughput and cost under the reported conditions and examines failure detection.

nexus-ai-tb-screening.title: Tuberculosis screening with AI in the field
nexus-ai-tb-screening.description: A deployment announcement from Google and Nexus AI describes X-ray screening, confirmatory testing, processing time, rollout by country and regulatory scope.

sequential-diagnosis-benchmark.title: What should a diagnostic AI ask next?
sequential-diagnosis-benchmark.description: A Science study asks models to choose questions and tests in sequence. Its reported 83.2% accuracy raises specific questions for clinical validation.

2027-01-15-2027-01-15.title: Building a personal AI environment
2027-01-15-2027-01-15.description: Practical notes on configuring a personal AI development environment and its architecture.

2024-03-17-english-word.title: Essential vocabulary
2024-03-17-english-word.description: An interactive collection of technical English vocabulary for computer vision.

2025-02-07-human-forecasting.title: Pedestrian trajectory and human pose forecasting
2025-02-07-human-forecasting.description: Research notes on predicting future human poses and trajectories from observed motion in computer vision and graphics.

2025-06-16-linux.title: Setting up a Linux development environment
2025-06-16-linux.description: Installation notes and a reference to Bash commands used in day-to-day development.

segmentation-from-pixels-to-robot-observ.title: Segmentation 01 — Understanding images one pixel at a time
segmentation-from-pixels-to-robot-observ.description: Stanford CS231n examples connect classification, detection, segmentation, score maps, FCNs, masks and IoU to the robotics RL series and Modern AI VI.

semiconductor-supply-chain-universe-map.title: A global map of the semiconductor supply chain
semiconductor-supply-chain-universe-map.description: An August 20, 2026 industry map connects demand, design, wafers, masks, fabrication, equipment, materials, components, packaging, HBM, test and service providers.

2026-03-30-venture-global-comprehensive-.title: Venture Global investment report and 2026 revenue forecast
2026-03-30-venture-global-comprehensive-.description: A company analysis of Venture Global (VG), including a forecast for 2026 revenue.

2025-02-18-vision.title: Computer vision study notes
2025-02-18-vision.description: Research notes on the core concepts, models and references of computer vision and deep learning.
